text:
rae: Quick thread  small "Snack Refapp" launch next week. Aim: 1 short blog post, 1 benchmark blurb, and a 30m livestream office hour. Need owners + basic timeline.

ali: I can draft the blog + 2 inline code snippets. Keep it under 500 words, dev-first.

marta: I'll run a light benchmark (256 tokens) and surface a single hero stat and a tiny CSV. Expect ~60 GPU minutes.

kevin: I'll coordinate livestream (Tuesday 11am PT) and set up registration + recording. Suggest live demo + 10m Q+A.

cleo: Inbound routing: map CTAs to 3 lists: trial users, community, maintainers. Also add UTM params and a small partner microflow.

rae: Requests: 1) Benchmark headline for LP hero (one sentence). 2) Blog CTA phrasing options: A) "Run the snack refapp in 5 mins" B) "Clone and get started now". Pick one for hero A/B.

ali: I'll take CTA A for hero A and draft the B variant as an experiment. Also will include a short GIF of the quickstart for the LP hero.

marta: Bench quick note: will compare default vs batching+cache on a 256-token chat sample. If numbers hold, hero: "~30% lower unit cost with batching + cache" (will qualify with reproducible link).

kevin: Registration cap 200. I'll wire registrants to CRM and tag by segment. Also will generate a short 3-min teaser clip for socials.

cleo: Routing detail: send maintainers an opt-in to a private review channel and a tiny maintainer checklist. Also create a partner path for early-access invites.

rae: Approve 60 GPU minutes for benchmark runs?

kevin: Approved. Please log under GH issue snack-refapp-launch.

launch-bot: Reminder set: create GH issue "snack-refapp-launch-playbook" and assign owners in 12 hours.

ali: Draft ETA: PR with blog + assets in 48h. Will ping for copy review.

marta: Will upload CSV + run script to /benchmarks/snack-refapp and link in the post.

rae: Owners recap: Ali=content & assets, Marta=benchmark & reproducibles, Kevin=webinar ops, Cleo=inbound routing. Post blockers here by EOD. :sparkles:
